### Added
- Support [environ credentials](https://github.com/ydb-platform/ydb-go-sdk-auth-environ#auth-environment-variables)
  for YDB using connection string parameter `use_env_credentials`.
### Changed
- Various dependency upgrades

- ClickHouse: new `goose_db_version` tables are created with `ORDER BY (version_id)` instead of
`goose azuresql "sqlserver://host?database=mydb&fedauth=ActiveDirectoryDefault" status`.
Excluded when building with the `no_mssql` or `no_azuresql` tags (#1109)
- MySQL/MariaDB table-based `Locker` via `lock.NewMySQLTableLocker`, the MySQL counterpart to the
Postgres table locker from #993, accepting the same `TableLockerOption` set (#1075)
- MySQL/TiDB: the `tstamp` column is now `DATETIME` instead of `TIMESTAM

**Graceful drain (v0.0.40).** On shutdown the server keeps serving briefly with `/readyz` failing, then drains, so a rolling deploy drops no requests. A Postgres or NATS outage no longer fails `/readyz`, and a Postgres error during auth answers 503, which SDKs retry, instead of a 401 they drop.
**Upgrading:** Postgres migration 028, which older pods ignore, so images roll in any order. No wire changes.

**Security fixes (v0.0.36).** Project reads no longer return the FCM service-account key, which any org member could read; rotate it if untrusted members had access. Redis trace spans no longer carry command arguments such as the cookieless salt. The demo user `woof@pug.sh`, whose password the README published, is now read-only and can't sign in with a password.
**Upgrading:** Postgres migration 027 and ClickHouse migration 014. Roll every image right after migrating, since older pods can fail on the droppe
**Upgrading:** three Postgres migrations (024–026), and no ClickHouse or NATS migrations. Go is now 1.26.9, which rebuilds every image, so update them all and roll the server before the dashboard.
